about: Which weather the fleet downloads (spec: Weather and wind, 'How the location stays private'; engine/src/flight_insights/weather/tiles.py). Each flight's positions are snapped on the laptop to large fixed tiles; the tiles it flew in, and every tile around them, join the download list for good. Only tile names leave the engine, never a position, and only to the shell, which turns each tile into its grid of points for the weather API.
sources: docs/SPEC.md, Weather and wind: 2 by 2 degree tiles plus their neighbours, from the logs on the laptop; the provider learns which large tiles the fleet works in, never a position

min_share: a tile counts when it holds at least 1% of the flight's positions, so a few samples from a GNSS glitch or a spoofed position do not add a tile; a flight crossing into the next tile is covered by the neighbours anyway
gps_min_status: GPS Status 3 is a 3D fix (libraries/AP_GPS/AP_GPS.h GPS_OK_FIX_3D at Copter-4.7.0); GPS positions are used only when the estimator's own (POS) are absent

grids_deg: each model's own grid, so every point asked for is a model cell and nothing is interpolated by the provider: ECMWF IFS HRES at 0.1 degrees (about 9 km, open data since 1 October 2025, https://openmeteo.substack.com/p/ecmwf-transitions-to-open-data), ERA5 at 0.25 degrees (https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/datasets/reanalysis-era5-single-levels); a 2 degree tile is 20 by 20 = 400 points at 0.1 degrees (its south and west edges and inside; the north and east edges are the next tiles'), within Open-Meteo's 1,000 locations a request (https://openmeteo.substack.com/p/weather-data-for-multiple-locations)
